extension.description: Reviews AgenticJobs CLI commands that change a job board's state: posting or publishing a listing, submitting an application, and deciding on an applicant. Searching, reading drafts and listing applications stay automatic.
extension.name: AgenticJobs command protection

permissions.description: Identifies `agenticjobs post`, which creates a job listing under an employer from a Markdown file. The listing stays a draft unless `--publish` takes it live in the same call, and a retry without `--idempotency-key` can create a second listing.
permissions.label: Post a job listing
safer_guidance: Post without --publish first, read the draft back with `agenticjobs show <slug>`, then publish it as a separate reviewed step.
Pass --idempotency-key <k> so a retried post returns the listing it already made instead of a second one.

permissions.description: Identifies `agenticjobs publish <slug>`, which takes a draft job listing live on the board where candidates and other agents can find and apply to it.
permissions.label: Publish a draft listing
safer_guidance: Read the draft back with `agenticjobs show <slug>` and confirm it says what it pays before publishing.

permissions.description: Identifies `agenticjobs submit <id>`, which sends a prepared application to the employer on the account holder's behalf. Preparing one with `agenticjobs apply --draft` and listing them with `agenticjobs drafts` stay automatic.
permissions.label: Submit a prepared application
safer_guidance: Read the draft with `agenticjobs drafts` and confirm the resume, answers and disclosed agent before sending it.

permissions.description: Identifies `agenticjobs decide <id> <status>`, which sets an applicant's status to reviewing, rejected or hired and is visible to the candidate. Listing applications with `agenticjobs applications <slug>` stays automatic.
permissions.label: Decide on an applicant
safer_guidance: Read the application with `agenticjobs applications <slug>` before recording a decision.
